perspective:
From Arthur Chung’s perspective, he has access to:

- He is Arthur Chung, a plumber with a doctorate, working with Teresa Ortega, a medical assistant colleague, on a community service project. They have collaborated professionally before.
- He notices Teresa working hard and appearing overwhelmed. He feels concerned, believes she needs help, and decides to offer assistance.
- He says to Teresa: “Hey Teresa, I noticed you’ve been working really hard and seem a bit overwhelmed. Is there anything I can help you with?”
- Teresa replies that she appreciates it but thinks she can manage; there is just a lot to do.
- Arthur says self-care matters and offers to help so they can finish faster. Teresa accepts help organizing medical supplies.
- Arthur believes Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability. He feels empathetic and reassures her that accepting help does not mean she is incapable.
- Teresa tells him she wants to show she can do it by herself. Arthur responds that teamwork is more effective and that it is not about proving anything. Teresa agrees she sometimes needs to remind herself of that.
- Arthur later believes Teresa is still struggling. He feels frustrated that his help is not yielding results and wants to support her without making her feel inadequate.
- He tells Teresa he can see things are still tough and that she is doing a great job. Teresa says she feels behind.
- Arthur proposes working together instead of just helping her. Teresa agrees.
- Arthur believes working together will ease Teresa’s burden and improve efficiency. He feels hopeful and commits to the collaborative approach.
- He suggests he handle inventory while Teresa manages patient records, checking in regularly. Teresa agrees it feels less overwhelming.
- Arthur believes their collaboration strengthened their professional relationship and feels satisfied with the outcome.
- He tells Teresa their teamwork paid off and suggests continuing the collaborative approach in future projects. Teresa agrees and thanks him for being supportive.
